svg.aria-label: One frame: sync, tick, publish, notify, reflect
svg.title: One frame: sync, tick, publish, notify, reflect
svg.desc: engine.step(now) as a loop with five stations. 01, sync: edits and presence from other people land. 02, tick: systems run, in eleven fixed phases. 03, publish: your presence goes out. 04, notify: observers fire, once. 05, reflect: only here is the DOM or the GPU written. Under the tick, its eleven phases in order: input, react, spawn, recognize, arbitrate, claim, behave, simulate, derive, present, cleanup. The five from spawn to behave are the control sweep, which take a pointer event to its first write with no added frames. The loop closes through requestAnimationFrame.
